RMB is already widely used. In 2025, CIPS transaction volume was about $25T. CIPS is the clearing system for international RMB transactions, so CIPS transaction volume is the best measure of international RMB usage. Sure, CIPS doesn't see the huge international transaction volumes of some other systems, but these huge volumes are mainly caused by forex trading which is not very important. RMB is not likely to become a major reserve currency because China has capital controls. China is never going to give up capital controls because they want both a controlled exchange rate and a free hand in monetary policy.
